# Bounded discovery record

1. Bit finite-inverse prefix expansion: 480 first-helper packets screened. 300 replacements passed the fixed frame-chain gate; all were neutral direct loads. The remaining 180 were blocked by this specific early-source frame schedule. This is not a general impossibility result.
2. Complex protected-syndrome screen: 324 protected columns, modulus 1000000007, 130 legal proportional-source nominations; none had strict immediate paid-profile gain. These modular results are discovery filters, not rational certificates.
3. Zero-incremental-frame-cost basis factoring and greedy frame-fee weighted factoring found no positive nomination in the bounded scan. No optimality claim follows.
4. One modular nomination was reconstructed over the rationals and passed the full native pipeline: A[33] source523 becomes minus source512. This changes the cold-dirt response and removes four compensation operations, while preserving all paid ranks.
5. PR534 frame assignment transfers constructively to static44 through exact successor intersections and frame joins. The resulting positive paid-profile change was fully replayed. It is public-mechanism composition, not a newly invented numerical technique.

Native discovery sources and complete negative results remain in the research lane. Shipping replay uses only frozen constructors; it does not perform search.
